note: Hand-authored. Subject makes statements and rarely asks; the observer asks most of the questions.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: what do you want to do about the weekend?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: I will drive down on Friday evening, that should work for everyone.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: should I bring anything?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Bring the projector, we were going to put the film on the wall.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: how long is the drive?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: About two hours if the ring road is clear, which it never is at that hour.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: ok, I'll leave around six

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Perfect, I will put the kettle on when you get here.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: did the invoice go out?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: It went out this morning, and they paid an hour later, which never happens.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: can you send me the receipt?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Sent, it is in the shared folder as well.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: what should we do with the leftover stock?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: We can hold it over to the autumn sale, it will not spoil.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: fine by me

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: I will put a note on the storage room door so nobody opens the boxes.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: are we still meeting at the usual place?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: We are, I will be there a bit early to grab a table.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: who else is coming?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Just the four of us, as far as I know.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: shall we order food when we get there?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: That would be easiest, the menu is enormous and nobody can decide.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: true, ok

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: I will get there at half past six then.
